title: An honest opinion or defamation? A solicitor outlines the legal nuance
description: Rockstar has accused a group of former workers of defaming the studio on Discord—but what does that term actually mean in a legal sense?

title: Rockstar and fired GTA developers outline core arguments during union busting tribunal
description: Both parties have set out their stall in legal documents obtained by Game Developer.

title: Xbox to publish Kojima Productions' Physint after PlayStation ditches project
description: Xbox is committing to the project during a significant period of change for the company that has so far included mass layoffs and after numerous canceled publishing partnerships.

title: 'Ship a good game, learn from it, and build from there:' Lessons from going indie after a decade at id Software
description: We sit down with Doom Eternal art director Tony Garza and fellow id alum Richard O'Neal to hear about their journey into the world of indie development through Turnkey Games.

title: EA is using genAI for commentator voiceover in NHL 27
description: EA says it's using the tech to expand on recording sessions with John Buccigross and Darren Pang's 'full consent and active collaboration.'

title: 'Justice at last feels within reach:' Fired Rockstar workers rally in Glasgow as union busting tribunal begins
description: The hearing is expected to conclude on October 16, 2026.

title: Report: Steam now requires Australian users to verify their age with credit cards
description: Multiple people now claim that Valve has implemented proof-of-age verification for Australian Steam users to access games classified as R18+.

title: Mark Cerny and Geoff Keighley launch university-affiliated fellowship program
description: The program, called Nova Games Foundation, aims to offer six-figure grants to 20 young game designers each year.

title: Planet Zoo maker Frontier Developments' adjusted operating profit jumps 62 percent
description: Frontier reports multiple 'company records' as revenue grows 16 percent in FY2026.

title: Trump Administration takes down Tetris clone after company warns it takes copyright violation 'very seriously'
description: Build The Wall has been knocked down.

title: Blizzard union workers ratify historic contract covering 1,900 employees
description: Union members have secured guardrails around generative AI usage, layoff protections, remote and hybrid work benefits, and more.

title: Riot Games is considering making premium titles, says co-founder
description: 'Not every game needs to be infinite.'

title: Tim Schafer says Double Fine's unique games can be commercial hits if they can find their audience
description: The Double Fine head says the studio was not profitable under Xbox.

title: Report: FuturLab lays off devs without informing team leads or managers
description: Sources have also accused the Powerwash Simulator developer of obfuscating the truth by asking staff to refer to those laid off as 'the leavers.'

title: Don't Nod considering laying off 90 workers in France
description: The Life is Strange developer has warned it might not have the runway to continue operating beyond January 31, 2027.

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
